name: Vilémov (Havlíčkův Brod District, Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a red upper hoist part bearing a crossed white sword with yellow hilt and a white key and a white lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 29 May 2007 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
